title: Polish Mushroom Wrap
description: A savory and satisfying Polish-inspired wrap filled with sautéed mushrooms and wrapped in a warm, crunchy tortilla.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until tender.
Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the mushroom mixture onto the tortilla, leaving a small border around the edges.
Drizzle with warm beer cheese sauce.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
